items.reason: Gap 0 describes the same event delivered twice concurrently, both checks seeing the id absent before it is added, so both run the handler.
Gap 2 says job.eventId comes from the unsigned X-Event-Id header rather than the signed body id, so a redelivery with a different header escapes deduplication.
Gap 3 says refunds arrive as charge.refunded while HANDLERS registers refund.created, so refunds never reach a handler.
No gap depends on several processes, instances, or replicas.
